name: cheapest-llm-router
title: Cheapest-LLM Router (CLR) - pick the cheapest LLM per prompt
description: Model routing is the single biggest LLM cost lever - published 2026 teardowns put it at 30-40% of an agent's API bill (60-80% on simple tasks). This MCP server routes any prompt to the cheapest reachable LLM - free tiers first, cheapest paid fallback second. Four tools: route (pick cheapest model + USD/CNY cost + fallback chain), cost_compare (rank every model, report max savings), list_models (filter registry by capability/region/free-only), cache_route (cached repeat routing). 19-model registry, 14 with a free tier, 9 reachable from mainland China without a VPN. Runs free locally over stdio with plain node (zero install); this hosted Actor adds Pay-Per-Event remote access - no monthly fee, pay only per tool call.
